method_note: Owner EXHAUSTIVE PER-LINE METHOD. 10 clips from data/audit_batches.json B21_200-209; dossiers data/line_trace/200..209. Read in full: the 18 dynamic emitters (incl. thunks sub_4203D0 and sub_420000), the 22 literal-only emitters' call-site eids, DriverNameIDLookup hits, the reachability chain (BufferReset, sub_4B3400, LapCompletion, AICornerSpeedComparison, AIVehicleDamageEvent, LapSplitTimeEvent, TimerFrameRateThrottle registration). Installed pitstop_failures 1.1.4-rc.1 source read for 188-190. No live game; owner exe read-only for the event table.
owner_exe_check: F1 Challenge Online.exe (sha256 prefix 1a70e5ed0c4a059f). Event table 0x5BF9A0 + eid*0x14: priority +0x00, cooldown +0x0C, score +0x10. eids 188-197 cooldown 1.0 with scores 191-200 (match dump); TV 507-511 cooldown 1.0; 397 cooldown 1.0 score 9875.
contradictions: doc56 row 190 says SILENT: correct for the native game, but pitstop_failures 1.1.4-rc.1 queues eid 190 (live_client.cpp:600), so it plays through the mod (MOD_ONLY).

modded_lines.json and the voice index cite pitstop dll/pit_commentary.c:590,110/111,1557 for eids 188/189. That file is not in the installed rc.1 tree; the installed path is pit_live_voice.h:30 + live_client.cpp:1068-1070.
RESTORATION_PLAN.md:253 says eid 188 has no call site. True for native code, false for the installed pitstop mod (186+wheel path).
doc56 row 230 says 196 SHIPPED. The native emitter (AIVehicleDamageEvent) supports it statically (NATIVE_ACTIVE, DERIVED); no mod source emits it.

eid 397 is emitted by several native functions (PitExit:127, PositionChangeDetector:111,189, RaceCommentary:148,173). The dump maps 397 to SDT 0 PWS_QUAL32 'Team front row lockout' (score 9875). Those pit/position paths would play the front-row clip unless the dump row is wrong. Outside this batch; flagged for the owner.

DriverNameIDLookup stores PWS eids 188-197 as per-driver name-slot values (e.g. line 273 'Juan' -> 188). The consumer of that name-slot eid is NOT located; no queue function reads it. Not an emit, but an open question.

TV twins 507, 509, 510, 511 (clips 197, 194, 195, 192) are literal emits in PitRaceStatusMessageDispatcher (sub_41BE60, eids 506-513, TV channel). Not analysed here (PWS scope); the TV channel may play them.

play_plan.meaning: Another (AI) car has just left the pits on intermediate tyres. Tyre-strategy information about a rival, not a warning to the player.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race (SessionType 7), green flag. An AI car (not the player) leaves the pit lane onto the track while its tyre is INTERMEDIATE.
play_plan.trigger: AI car pit_status edge 4 -> 0 (broker pit_status; raw veh+0x3450 per brief) with controller_role == 1 and tyre compound == INTERMEDIATE. Compound locator: UNKNOWN - F1CBrokerVehicleSnapshot (f1c_broker_abi.h:160-214) has no tyre compound field; a live-proven per-car compound read is needed.
play_plan.subject: AI driver id veh+0x489C (NOT veh+0x48A0)
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (ERE queues PWS eid 191 with AI subject; no native gate to lift)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per car per pit exit (ERE latch until next pit visit); table cooldown 1.0 s
play_plan.must_not_play_when: player's own exit; qualifying (SessionType 5); car retired or lapped out; compound is not INTERMEDIATE; Safety Car period; within ~10 s of another pit-exit line
play_plan.conflicts: PitExit native lines 397 and 516-535 fire on the same exit edge; RE_OD siblings 192-194 share the trigger; pitstop_failures lines use their own box-stop path
play_plan.calibration: compound locator (none yet); exit-edge timing vs the PitExit call
play_plan.live_test: Race in wet conditions: let an AI car pit onto inters and watch the exit; or an ERE debug trigger with a known compound
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED meaning and line identity; GUESS on compound locator; raise by a live read of per-car tyre compound
